messages.text: How do you get anyone router to increase the quantity of monthly $anyone tokens
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me check what's actually known about how the router's rewards are calculated before I answer.
Searched the web · Anyone Protocol router rewards how to increase ANYONE tokens

Hal here, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Good question, and it is one you can actually act on once the unit is in your hands.

Rewards on Anyone Protocol are scored per round by the protocol, not by us, so what you control is the quality of the relay your router presents to the network. 
Relays in the ANYONE network earn rewards based on the bandwidth and quality of service they provide.


What moves the number:

1. Uptime, first and foremost. 
The scoring tracks per-relay uptime and computes multi-day uptime streaks
, so an unplugged or rebooting router costs you more than a slow one. Keep it on a stable circuit, ideally a small UPS.
2. Wired, not wireless. Put it on Ethernet to your main router and keep its ORPort reachable from outside. A relay that cannot be reached from the internet does not publish and does not score.
3. Real upstream bandwidth. Scoring uses the relay's consensus weight, which follows measured throughput, so the router is limited by whatever upload your ISP gives it. Do not throttle it with QoS rules, and give it a spot where it is not competing with heavy upload traffic.
4. Reward eligibility. 
A relay is only scored if it is running with non-zero consensus weight, has a verified operator address, and is reward-eligible (registered hardware, or an operator lock matching the verified address).
 So register the device under your wallet in the Anyone dashboard and confirm it shows as verified, otherwise it relays traffic and earns nothing.
5. Location matters a little. 
Each relay is placed in a geographic cell to compute location diversity
, which means rewards favour relays in areas with few others. Nothing you can change at home, but it is part of why two identical routers earn differently.

One thing I will not do is quote you a monthly token figure. The per-round distribution depends on the whole network, and I do not have numbers I trust.
